ciAtTestedHead: Read on GitHub, not re-run: at 0fb74300 lint, typecheck, test, build, pr-title and the envoy lanes success; at 5a5dcd0a (handoff-only, skip-checks) the daemon carries green and pr-title is queued.
notes: A1a-A1e and A2 on main run first after the merge; the production check owns them (plan A2). The main-only paths I could reach without main were run: the cache-to gate expression was exercised with the branch ref by temporary commit 2444de11/17fa916a (run 40453177184 exported the registry cache), and Advance latest's imagetools create was dry-run against the new index.

Re-run behaviour: main run 40153231727 attempt 2 re-ran its build legs and replaced their same-named artifacts with no 409, so the new envoy-image-digest-<arch> artifacts behave the same on a full re-run. Their retention-days: 1 means a re-run of image_index alone more than a day after a leg finds no digests and stops with 'expected 2 digests … found 0'; a re-run of all jobs recovers. Reported to the architect, not a failure.

Risk reported to the architect for decision: the registry cache envoy:buildcache-<arch> can be written by any branch run that holds packages: write (run 40453177184 did, from this branch), and main's attested build reads it. The type=gha cache it replaces could not be written for main by a branch run. This comes from spec v3 and the INFRA-520 pattern (#2316), not from a deviation in this PR.
